title: Enforcement recommendations

permissionsUnavailable.title: Permissions unavailable
permissionsUnavailable.body: Your permissions could not be verified. No recommendation data or action is shown; retry the page.

unauthorized.title: Authorized role required
unauthorized.body: This queue is available to Inspector, Planner, Ops, Compliance Admin, Auditor, Reviewer and Leadership roles.

config.title: Enforcement policy: Not configured.
config.body: We are waiting for the sponsor to send two things. First, the approved list of measures. Second, the official legal words for each one, with the law and its version. Until then we show no amount, no next step and no legal words.

scope.title: Decision scope
scope.body: You can read decisions but not change them yet. When approval is switched on, it will record the decision only. It will not issue a penalty or close a factory. It will not send a legal notice or skip any enforcement step.

readonly.title: View only for your role
readonly.body: You can view this list. To decide, you need an Operations or Compliance Admin role — the database enforces this.

loadError: The recommendation queue is unavailable in this environment. No count is claimed.
awaitingDecider: Waiting for a decision from Operations or a Compliance Admin.
decidedLoadError: Recent decisions are unavailable. No count is shown.

decide.success: Decision recorded. The recommendation queue will refresh.

error.auth_required: Your session is unavailable. Sign in again.
error.already_decided: This recommendation was already decided. Refresh the queue.
error.maker_checker: The recommender cannot decide their own recommendation.
error.write_failed: The decision could not be recorded. No change was claimed.
error.backend_guard_required: You cannot record a decision yet. A safe database step still needs to be added.
